transcription: I think I was date-raped at 15 by a Romanian gang. At 15, I was your typical foster care kid. Constantly running away, staying wherever I could. One night me and my friend were out, when we were approached by a group of random older boys. This wasn't new to us. We always hung around with people we didn't know. We were stupid kids who thought we could protect ourselves. We had seen them around a lot, and knew they were part of a Romanian gang in barking. They offered us to their house, without specifying where it was. We weren't bothered. We were just cold and tired. We traveled for what seemed ours from London. Until we reached a house. I had no idea where we were, but didn't ask. The train ride was already a bit iffy. I wanted to go back, but my friend didn't. But it was too late to turn back anyway. The trains were stopping as it was late. As I walked into the house with my friend, I noticed there was no living room. Every room was filled with beds. I started to panic, but they reassured everything was okay, so I idiotically stayed. They offered me some wine and poured it into an already open red bull can. That should have been my cue to get the hell out. But I didn't. I was a stupid kid. I had a puff on a joint which was nothing new. Time passed and I started to feel weird. Everyone sounded like they were really far away and I saw a green floating triangle float by my face. I remember it like yesterday. Everyone ran over including my friend and asked if I was okay. I must have looked weird. I told them I needed to sit down. As they took me to the front room I laid and stared at the ceiling. I felt paralyzed. A guy was talking to me but I couldn't make one what he was saying to me. Then I blacked out. When I woke up my phone, which I usually kept in my bra was gone. I started to panic. I looked up to see my friend on another bed and with one of the men next to her. I started to panic and ran over to wake her up. My legs felt like jelly. I shook her and asked the boys where my effing phone was. They gave it to me and I pulled my friend up. And told them we were going. They had my tobacco and asked if they could roll a fag before I went. I said no and they stood by the door not allowing me to get out. I started to scream and threw the tobacco at them. Next thing I know, I blink and me and my friend are outside a Tesco. Like we had blinked and got there. It was terrifying. I looked up to see we were at Birmingham.
